ui_hover.why: Round 2 (round 1 gave 0.5 s whispers or bead trains): one soft fingertip tap, 0.10 s, 5 ms attack, warm (500 Hz); low-passed at 9 kHz.

card_hover.why: Shortest clean paper slide (0.27 s, no second hit); a1-a4 drag on for 0.35-0.45 s.

select.why: One warm wooden tick (centroid 1.9 kHz), instant onset, very low noise floor; b takes are thin 9-12 kHz pins.

click_primary.why: Compact brass-on-wood click (90 ms, one hit, 1.9 kHz); brighter than click_secondary, not as sharp as b4 (6.5 kHz).

click_secondary.why: Single dull leather-and-wood knock (5 ms attack, 770 Hz), the darker partner of click_primary; others double-hit or ring.

back.why: One soft book-cover thump with a paper swish (0.18 s, dark); the b takes knock twice 200 ms apart, too slow for Back.

confirm.why: Warm brass bell (1.9 kHz) with a clean decay; the glass b takes are 6-8 kHz and fatiguing for a cue heard every turn.

cancel.why: Muted marimba blip falling away (630 Hz), soft and short; the parchment b takes are sub-heavy.

deny.why: Dull padlock tug (640 Hz) with a little rattle: clearly 'no' without a harsh buzz; a1 is the same gesture but brighter.

tab.why: Round 2: one soft leather-tab slap (0.19 s, instant); round 1 was sub-only thumps or 100-300 ms page turns. High-pass lowered to 60 Hz to keep its body.

toggle_on.why: The latch: two tiny clicks in 0.13 s, exactly the old two-step latch; softened above 9 kHz.

toggle_off.why: A single latch click opening (0.2 s); softened above 9 kHz to sit with toggle_on.

slider_tick.why: Round 2: the shortest single bead click (0.16 s, instant), softened above 7 kHz so a drag of ticks never hisses.

panel_open.why: Parchment unrolling with a faint shimmer, trimmed to 0.6 s; the b takes are page flutters with 8 separate hits.

panel_close.why: Book closing: one soft thump (5 ms attack, 0.35 s), the natural end of panel_open.

customise_select.why: Round 2: a warm token set in a tray with a low chime (3 kHz, instant, one event); round 1 was all 10 kHz sparkle.

deck_add.why: Card tucked into the stack: quickest slide (45 ms) ending in a tick, 0.32 s.

deck_remove.why: Round 2: a quick card flick off the stack (50 ms rise, 0.26 s), the partner of deck_add; round 1 took 120-240 ms to arrive.

chat.why: One clean glass bell (2 kHz) with a long soft decay: a gentle message chime under the game sounds.

chat_pop.why: Bubble pop then a bell ting (two events, the old pop-and-chime gesture), very clean floor (-64 dB).

step_done.why: Small rising chime (3.2 kHz), instant, 0.55 s; a3/a4 are thinner sparkles.

zone_pick.why: One soft token clack with a shimmer, 0.22 s, instant.

card_draw.why: Quick swipe off the deck (70 ms rise, crest at 70 ms, 0.34 s) with the sparkle; the a takes swell for 200 ms.

card_play.why: Crisp paper snap and table tap in 0.2 s, one event; the b takes have 3 separate hits.

card_set.why: Soft muffled face-down thud (1 kHz, 0.32 s), the quiet cousin of card_play.

card_slam.why: Layered: b2's woody slap (1.7 kHz, instant; reads on small speakers) over a1's deep table thump (the body the old slam had); either alone is too thin or too subby under the climax.

card_discard.why: Card flicked onto a pile, 0.31 s, quick (35 ms).

card_return.why: Reverse swish back to the hand, shortest rise (150 ms) of the four.

card_shuffle.why: Riffle shuffle that starts at once (40 ms) with an even, crisp riffle across 1.4 s.

card_flip.why: Crisp flip with a shimmer, 45 ms attack, 0.34 s, one event (identical for every card).

stance_attack.why: Blade drawn with a ring, quickest of the a takes; the b takes rise for 200 ms.

stance_defense.why: Shield braced: one solid knock (400 Hz) with a little clank, 0.37 s.

attack.why: Sword swing with the clearest high swish (1.3 kHz centroid) and a 50 ms rise; most takes are bassy whooshes.

impact.why: Weapon on armour with mid-range crunch (550 Hz) and a very clean tail; the a takes are sub only.

damage.why: Round 2: a punch with a crunchy crack that lands at once (crest 30 ms, 290 Hz body); round 1 was sub rumble (40-110 Hz) that small speakers lose.

block.why: Clang plus a solid thump in 0.52 s, instant; the a takes ring on for a full second.

destroy.why: Crunchy shatter with debris, instant (0 ms attack), 2 kHz, the old splinter gesture.

exhaust.why: Void pull: swells for 0.4 s then falls away into nothing (the old reversed swell), dark (540 Hz).

sacrifice.why: Card catching fire: immediate ignition (20 ms) and crackle, the brightest (870 Hz) of a bass-heavy set.

boom.why: The boom with the most crack and mid-range (220 Hz centroid; the a takes are clipped 45 Hz rumble); round 2's c takes were no brighter.

charge.why: A true riser (its crest at 0.98 s, 1.9 kHz): shaped to crest at 1.3 s and let go into the boom.

heal.why: Warm harp-like rise (1.5 kHz) with an immediate start; the a takes are 10 kHz glitter.

buff.why: Bright brassy shimmer up, instant, 0.87 s.

debuff.why: Descending warped hex tone, 25 ms attack, 0.92 s.

ap_gain.why: Round 2: a warm two-note amber chime (1.8 kHz); round 1 was 9-11 kHz glitter, too sharp for a cue heard every turn.

ap_loss.why: Short dull crystal dimming (2 kHz, 0.28 s, instant).

hp_low_heartbeat.why: Clear lub-dub (two beats) with a warm body; played 12 dB down in code.

status_rune.why: Stone hum with a chime, immediate (10 ms), 550 Hz body: a glyph waking.

status_retain.why: Round 2: a golden seal latching with a resonant chime (6 kHz, fuller); round 1 was all 11 kHz chain jingle.

status_reveal.why: Airy reveal shimmer with the cleanest floor (-61 dB) and the darkest top of the four.

status_eternal.why: Full radiant shimmer with slow harmonic movement (holy, 4.7 kHz), instant.

status_burn.why: Ignition whoosh right on the onset (10 ms) into crackling flames.

status_pierce.why: Metal stab and scrape with a ring, quickest (35 ms) and cleanest (-76 dB floor).

status_cleanse.why: Clear water splash with chimes, crest at 90 ms.

status_paralyse.why: Electric zap that starts on the frame (10 ms) and buzzes; the others take 150-350 ms to arrive.

status_medic.why: Warm bell and hum (720 Hz) with the cleanest floor (-62 dB).

status_curse.why: Round 2: a sinister falling dissonant chime with a ghostly whoosh (630 Hz, unclipped); round 1 was clipped 90 Hz rumble.

status_poison.why: Tight cluster of wet bubbles then a hiss, instantly recognisable.

status_infiltrate.why: Soft dark slip-past whoosh with the most mid content (260 Hz) of four bass whooshes.

status_blind.why: Round 2: a smoke puff that bursts at once (25 ms) with a muffled hiss; round 1 was clipped sub.

status_nimble.why: Round 2: a quick airy dodge swish with a little chime (1.9 kHz, 55 ms).

status_debilitate.why: Falling, wilting harmonic tone (visible downward glide), instant.

status_blocked.why: Dull glassy deflection ping, instant, 0.66 s.

status_expire.why: Descending dissolving shimmer, darkest and smoothest of four.

burn_tick.why: Short flame crackle, instant (10 ms), 0.62 s.

poison_tick.why: Sickly bubble pop and hiss, instant.

summon.why: Shimmer that lands at once (crest 70 ms, 3 kHz) and rings out: fancy but on the card's arrival; the a takes swell for 200-450 ms.

fusion_vortex.why: Swirling riser with an audible rising sweep (2.4 kHz); shaped to crest at 0.72 s and let go before the climax.

fusion_impact.why: Layered: b3's immediate deep boom (lands on the flash) under a1's shimmering chord bloom (crest 0.5 s): the forge, then the glory.

ritual_choir.why: Round 2: low brass and timpani crescendo (500 Hz body; round 1 was sub-only drone), shaped to crest at 0.8 s and let go before the gong.

ritual_impact.why: Temple gong: immediate, one strike, the most mid-range body (lf share 0.49) with a long dark tail.

arcane_shimmer.why: A genuine glass riser (crest 1.36 s); its last 0.76 s before the crest, shaped and released before the climax.

arcane_impact.why: Blooms in over 185 ms (H28: no hit), crest 0.31 s on the flash, glassy 6 kHz shimmer with a long airy tail.

fuse.why: Legacy cue: rising converging shimmer (3.2 kHz), cleanest tail.

ritual.why: Legacy cue: pulsing dark drone into a drum strike, cleanest floor.

arcane.why: Legacy cue: glassy chime run, 2.4 kHz.

spell_cast.why: Swoosh that blooms within 110 ms (K1: swells, lands with the card) into a radiant tail; brighter than the Trap.

trap_spring.why: Snap on the landing, then a dark low sting at 0.94 s (K1: snap plus menace), darker (990 Hz) than the Spell.

serpent_coil.why: Long menacing hiss and scales, swelling to 0.35 s.

serpent_strike.why: Edited: the take's whoosh (0-0.3 s) runs straight into its splash, moved from 0.9 s to land at 0.23 s, when the strike hits the plate (FxSerpent IMPACT_AT - STRIKE_AT).

evolve_charge.why: Organic crackling rise cresting at 0.72 s, 1.8 kHz; the clearest build of four.

evolve_burst.why: Balanced burst (2.2 kHz, some low end) that blooms to 0.53 s and rings for 2.7 s.

copy_form.why: Wobbling liquid morph with a mirror tone (2.8 kHz), clearest of four.

control_steal.why: Warbling dark swirl drawing in, the only take without stray hits.

control_return.why: Unwinding swirl with a release chime (4.2 kHz): the bright counterpart of control_steal.

turn.why: Bronze bell, instant, with no sub rumble (lf share 0) and a long warm ring.

phase.why: Airy whoosh with a two-tone chime, quick (15 ms), very clean floor.

notice.why: Clean single bell ding (2.1 kHz), the cleanest floor.

prompt_alert.why: Two quick crystal notes, pleasant, instant.

opponent_responding.why: Soft pulsing low hum with no sub rumble: present but patient.

hourglass_flip.why: Glass clunk then sand trickling, 1.3 s, instant.

timer_tick.why: One dry clock tick (1.7 kHz), no ring.

timer_warning.why: Bronze bell tolled with urgency (2 kHz), instant.

game_start.why: Horn fanfare over war-drum hits (two hits in the first 0.3 s), 3 s, the call to battle.

coin_flip.why: Flick ping and spinning ring (1.1 s); the takes with a landing put it at 1.2 s, but the coin lands at 1.7 s (the landing keeps its own impact).

victory.why: Bright joyful fanfare that starts at once (70 ms) and resolves in 2.3 s.

victory_big.why: Grand fanfare that decays naturally over 4.3 s; a1-a4 cut off abruptly (generation artefact).

defeat.why: Somber descending horn phrase, quick start, 2.7 s, no sub rumble.

series_point.why: Gold coin clink with a shimmer (5.7 kHz), two clean hits; the others rattle 7-10 times.

reward_reveal.why: Chest opening into a sparkle, darkest (6.6 kHz) with the cleanest floor (-72 dB).

reward_pick.why: Gem set in its socket: bright ping with a brass click, the least piercing of four.

draft_reveal.why: Cards fanned out with a shimmer, 0.75 s, fewest separate hits.

draft_pick.why: Decisive card snap plus a chime, 20 ms attack.

sacrifice_mode_on.why: Low ritual flame catching, instant (10 ms).

sacrifice_mode_off.why: Flame snuffed: the quickest (25 ms) of four soft whooshes.

target_arm.why: Bow string drawn: creak starting at once, trimmed to 0.7 s.

target_lock.why: Crisp lock-on click with a short ping, 0.35 s.
